name: Ad Inserter – Ad Manager
description: Manages and inserts advertising blocks/code into the site.
project_description:
Ad Inserter is an ad management tool that allows for the display of rendered HTML and JavaScript ads. It provides functionality to show and hide ads based on screen size, differentiating between mobile and desktop screens. Future updates will include loading or rendering via JavaScript for enhanced performance.
